items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: I bought that house from Charlie Gomeske, that owned the baseball park.

ctx.x: Riggle, yeah. And then I moved from South Park over to the, that's the one, 31. Yes. That's right down the street near, right off of 31st Street. I bought that house from Charlie Gomeske, that owned the baseball park. Oh, yes. All the kids were there. The White South. I mean the baseball. The White South. And I lived there until my mother died. Well, my mother died, I just couldn't live there, so I won't see it.
No, it's good to have a change in the case of that. That was in 31. Then you moved out here.
